name: 鱼病发生率（环境因素）风险评估

map.输入水温、溶氧、pH、氨氮等水质参数，评估鱼病发生风险等级: Assess fish disease risk from environmental factors such as temperature and water quality.
map.📖 查看「养殖环境风险评分使用指南」: 📖 View the "Farming Environment Risk Score Guide"
map.鱼病风险 = f(水温, 密度, 水质): Fish disease risk = f(water temperature, density, water quality)
map.📚 深度解析：养殖环境风险评分: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Farming Environment Risk Score
map.放苗或换季前对水温、DO、pH、氨氮、亚硝酸盐、密度等环境因子评分，预判发病风险: Before stocking or at the change of season, score environmental factors such as water temperature, DO, pH, ammonia nitrogen, nitrite and density to anticipate disease risk.
map.参照 GB 11607、NY 5051 等水质基准，识别超标因子。: Refer to water-quality baselines such as GB 11607 and NY 5051 to identify out-of-range factors.
map.风险偏高时给出换水、吸附、降密等管理建议。: When the risk is high, give management advice such as water exchange, adsorption and reducing density.
map.鲤鱼、25℃、DO 5、pH 7.5、氨氮 0.5、亚硝 0.1、密度 1500: Common carp, 25 ℃, DO 5, pH 7.5, ammonia nitrogen 0.5, nitrite 0.1, density 1500 fish/mu
map.默认参数下各因子均在安全区，风险评分低（示例为 1 级），提示水质参数安全、风险: With the default parameters all factors are in the safe range and the risk score is low (level 1 in the example), indicating safe water-quality parameters and low risk; if ammonia nitrogen or nitrite rises or the density is too high, the score and level rise accordingly and water-exchange or adsorption advice is given.
map.评分依据什么？: What is the score based on?
map.综合水温适宜区间、溶氧下限、氨氮/亚硝酸盐阈值与: It combines the suitable water-temperature range, the dissolved-oxygen lower limit, the ammonia nitrogen and nitrite thresholds and
map.等，参照渔业水质标准打分。: and scores them against fishery water-quality standards.
map.风险评分是预警，仍需日常巡塘与病原监测，环境骤变时及时复评。: The risk score is an early warning; daily pond patrols and pathogen monitoring are still needed, and re-assess promptly when the environment changes abruptly.
map.水温骤变>3°C即可引发应激，免疫力下降易感染病菌: An abrupt water-temperature change of >3°C alone can trigger stress, lowering immunity and easing infection
map.溶氧<3mg/L时鱼类浮头，<1mg/L可致泛塘死亡: At DO <3 mg/L fish gasp at the surface, and <1 mg/L can cause pond-wide death
map.氨氮对鱼类有直接毒性，非离子氨(NH3)毒性更大: Ammonia nitrogen is directly toxic to fish, and un-ionised ammonia (NH3) is even more toxic
map.亚硝酸盐导致\"褐血病\"，影响携氧能力: Nitrite causes "brown blood disease", impairing oxygen-carrying capacity
map.高温季节(7-9月)是鱼病高发期，应加强水质监测: The hot season (July to September) is a peak period for fish disease, so strengthen water-quality monitoring
map.鱼病发生风险评估工具，输入水温、溶氧、pH、氨氮等水质参数，综合评估鱼病风险等级: A fish disease risk assessment tool: enter water-quality parameters such as temperature, dissolved oxygen, pH and ammonia nitrogen to assess the fish disease risk level comprehensively and receive management advice.
map.六项水质参数综合评估: Comprehensive assessment of six water-quality parameters
